profile.description: Active downtown Lewiston classic-car event with 300+ cars and community activities. Current downtown footprint does not have room for Adventure Zone.

contacts.name: Ben Bonfield
contacts.role: Event contact / Dailyfly Media General Manager

notes.subject: Downtown footprint too small; later thread was equipment discussion
notes.body: Ben Bonfield replied Aug. 5, 2026 that the car show is held in downtown Lewiston and he does not have space for an Adventure Zone setup. The later Aug. 5-6 messages were not renewed booking interest; Ben separately asked Amy about a jumping castle he had purchased secondhand for $1,500 and sent photos after Amy asked about it. Current event listings confirm Hot August Nights remains active. Do not misread the equipment discussion as event interest; only revisit if the event footprint changes.
